changelog_en: 💾 Native .smgsong Studio Project Save/Open (Ctrl+S / Ctrl+O) with Windows Explorer file association & cross-stage state sync

✍️ Upgraded Wizard, Visual Arranger, Editor & Song DNA Cloner with DAW Section Jump Bar, A/B Take Compare, Custom User Presets, Energy Curve & Originality Meter
🛡️ Hardened Windows x64 standalone build with bundled VC++ runtime DLLs, SSL certifi bundle, QtMultimedia/PIL/NumPy & Khmer fonts for zero-error execution on any PC
